definition: Term discrimination is a way to rank keywords in how useful they are for information retrieval.
details: Term discrimination is a way to rank keywords in how useful they are for information retrieval.
story: Think of a referee whose job is to be completely honest about who touched the ball last. Before trusting a machine, someone has to measure how good it really is — fairly and honestly. It is the exam that separates “it sounds good” from “it actually is good”. What gets measured is what actually gets better. And that, done honestly, is Term discrimination.
